intent.goal: find Gmail messages containing the word 'test'
intent._validation_feedback: SQL Error: no such column: page_id

generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT 
u.page_id,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.sender_email,
u.database_name
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE 
(u.database_name = 'gmail' OR u.database_name = 'trass.gmail')
AND (
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%test%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%test%'
    OR LOWER(g.sender_name) LIKE '%test%'
    OR LOWER(g.sender_email) LIKE '%test%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1000
